name: League of Aeronauts
description: A group of pilots from which the Consulate recruits.

timeline.summary: The Consulate recruits pilots from the League of Aeronauts, many of whom command fleets.
timeline.quote: The Consulate recruits its best pilots from the League of Aeronauts. Many go on to command entire fleets.
